testCase.name: [dev] S25 Deleting a point asks once and a double tap removes at most one; a blank or double-clicked Save Point adds nothing extra (both modes)

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S25 「删要点要确认一次，双击最多删一条；空白的或双击的 Save Point 不会多加东西（两个模式）」 Deleting a point asks once and a double tap removes at most one; a blank or double-clicked Save Point adds nothing extra (both modes)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 Every delete asks for confirmation once; there is no bulk delete.（TFA-94699 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57).（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; …（TFA-92590 AC 4；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each seeded with three points

When In each mode: tap Delete point on the first card once; then confirm; then double-tap Delete point on the second card and confirm once. Then Add Point with only spaces and Save Point; Add Point 'Double-tap check' and double-click Save Point

Then A single tap shows a confirmation and the point is still listed; after confirming only that point is gone; the double tap removes only the second point; there is no delete-all; the blank point makes no card; the double-clicked Save Point makes exactly one 'Double-tap check' card

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 6 (whether it covers points is Q7); main deletes on one tap: expected Fail. backendChecks after the run, each mode: texts == ['Delete-check three', 'Double-tap check'] exactly (count 2: no blank card, one 'Double-tap check' card; T5)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
